aidengmj_wwjd: Matthias "Tin" Wwjd signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-R13 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Matthias "Tin" Wwjd stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A round went through the rim of Matthias "Tin" Wwjd's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti of the Hegemony (@coletonmartin). The clerk counted the names twice. Matthias "Tin" Wwjd is number 885 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. After the loss of Grey Mill, Matthias "Tin" Wwjd helped stack spare sandbags at S-R13. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A bullet went through Matthias "Tin" Wwjd's upper arm at S-R13 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Severin Champions of the Hegemony (@_champions). Matthias "Tin" Wwjd looked over the parapet at S-R13 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Severin Champions of the Hegemony (@_champions).
The House of Wwjd sent Silas Wwjd after Matthias "Tin" Wwjd. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Silas Wwjd fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-R13. Roland "Spark" Nothing was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Silas Wwjd (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at Blackwater Canal. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Edmund Szymanski: 'Fair trade.'
On dawn watch at S-R13, Silas Wwjd fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Severin Heheheha, now grazed.
Silas Wwjd was hit in the foot through his boot at S-R13. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Ulrich "Mud" Potato of the Hegemony (@boiled_potato31).
Silas Wwjd healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
andrew_op56: "You're late," said the corporal when Quentin Andrew arrived on Day 11. "Everyone's late. Get a spade." On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Quentin Andrew wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Quentin Andrew fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Clement "Rabbit" Shadowwraith, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home reached Quentin Andrew before dusk. Quentin Andrew read it twice and slept a little easier.
Quentin Andrew wrote a song about Calvary Farm. Valentin Bascinetpupp wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.

Quentin Andrew felt a hard tug at his hip at P-F17. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Florian Art of the Concord (@c_crash_trash_art).

Machine-gun fire swept P-F17. Quentin Andrew took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Ivo Ursarte of the Concord (@not_ursarte). Quentin Andrew was killed at P-F17 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Ivo Ursarte of the Concord (@not_ursarte).
Walter Andrew came to the front because his father Quentin Andrew never came home. He carries a stub of a pencil.
Walter Andrew carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Walter Andrew approved the method.
asher_g5: The old hands of R-F18 have been here since Day 1. Ulrich Asher has been here since Day 3. In a trench, that difference already feels like years. From Verdel Ridge the Concord guns have a clear view. Ulrich Asher wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
An empty jam tin became Ulrich Asher's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
Ulrich Asher polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

Ulrich Asher saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Ulrich Asher helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Ulrich Asher and Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Ulrich Asher waited for the password before answering.
Ulrich Asher found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Ulrich Asher traded his mother's thimble for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Ulrich Asher let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

New laces made Ulrich Asher's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Ulrich Asher answered to number 182. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Ulrich Asher shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Blast from a trench mortar threw Ulrich Asher against the trench wall at R-F18. Ringing ears, a split lip, and no intention of leaving.
The wound on Ulrich Asher's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Ulrich Asher drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Ulrich Asher won before reaching the end of his entry.
Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Ulrich Asher only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F18, then nothing but pain. Raider: Bastian Wizzerd of the Concord (@flying_wizzerd).
The medic looked at Ulrich Asher's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F18. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
band_bro.1: On Day 9 Cyril Bro took a post at Q-S11 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He knows every star by name, and the men liked him for it. Cyril Bro transferred to the snipers. The men in Q-S11 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Cyril Bro looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. A letter from home found Cyril Bro before the night shift. Cyril Bro folded it small and kept it close.

Cyril Bro noticed regular flashes from a crack in an old stone wall. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious. A letter from home found Cyril Bro before the night shift. Cyril Bro folded it small and kept it close. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Cyril Bro watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

The parcel for Cyril Bro contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade. A letter from home found Cyril Bro before the night shift. Cyril Bro folded it small and kept it close.

Cyril Bro watched a crack in an old stone wall through another shift. The flash returns at the same angle, even when nothing else moves. A letter from home found Cyril Bro before the night shift. Cyril Bro folded it small and kept it close.

Cyril Bro thought about a wife and a daughter he has never met on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter. A letter from home found Cyril Bro before the night shift. Cyril Bro folded it small and kept it close.
Cyril Bro tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Stoneyford. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
Cyril Bro watched the enemy lines change the guard at Q-S11 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Leopold Cbr was gravely wounded.

A second observer helped Cyril Bro confirm the trick: a piece of glass, placed to draw fire. The real watching point must be elsewhere. A thin letter reached Cyril Bro. Only five lines long, and Cyril Bro knew every one of them by heart before supper.
brayden27727: Isidor "Tin" Brayden came up on Day 8 carrying news from Esterhaus. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
A dog crosses no man's land at the Sunken Road every night, fed by Jonas "Mole" Biesc on one side and Isidor "Tin" Brayden on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy.

Isidor "Tin" Brayden went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Concord trench Emil Batman put up a fight, but not for long. (@ba_ba_ba_batman) The raid hit the Concord line at the darkest hour. Isidor "Tin" Brayden fought Rafael Davidsonmars in a trench no wider than a door. Isidor "Tin" Brayden came home with Rafael Davidsonmars's cap badge. (@davidsonmarshall) Blackwater Canal has been won. Isidor "Tin" Brayden listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Isidor "Tin" Brayden shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Isidor "Tin" Brayden answered to number 526. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Isidor "Tin" Brayden folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Isidor "Tin" Brayden censored the men's letters tonight. He crossed out the place names and left in all the love.
Isidor "Tin" Brayden brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load.
Isidor "Tin" Brayden had orders to attack at dawn. He wrote back asking for artillery first. The orders were cancelled. Nobody knows which of his words did it.
Isidor "Tin" Brayden checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Isidor "Tin" Brayden asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Isidor "Tin" Brayden's hands still remember being a coal miner's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
brianz149: Emil Brianz took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In V-F14, Emil Brianz listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Emil Brianz and Wendel Jaranda made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it. A letter from home found Emil Brianz before the night shift. Emil Brianz folded it small and kept it close.

A clear shot from V-F14. Emil Brianz badly wounded Karel Hungry and slid back down below the parapet. A letter from home found Emil Brianz before the night shift. Emil Brianz folded it small and kept it close.

Emil Brianz fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Ulrich "Hollow" Gregory, grazed. A letter from home found Emil Brianz before the night shift. Emil Brianz folded it small and kept it close.

Emil Brianz fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Jonas "Saint" Jhartbomber was gravely wounded. A letter from home found Emil Brianz before the night shift. Emil Brianz folded it small and kept it close.

Emil Brianz heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously. The letter for Emil Brianz smelled faintly of soap. Emil Brianz held it close for a long time before opening it.

Emil Brianz followed a cough through the fog and found the ration party stuck at a junction. For once, a cough improved supper. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Emil Brianz anyway.
c._.gib: Jakub "Rabbit" Gib walked into V-F4 on Day 15 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Jakub "Rabbit" Gib rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Casimir Helton was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
Jakub "Rabbit" Gib and Bastian Salvib cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
cody13g: In Tannenfeld, Dorian "Spark" Cody was a choir singer. In P-F8, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a choir singer again.

An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Dorian "Spark" Cody helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dorian "Spark" Cody wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

A bullet went through Dorian "Spark" Cody's upper arm at P-F8 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Pavel Schizophreni of the Hegemony (@schizophrenicwizard). Two shots, one miss. The second found Walter Arcadialoren, grazed. Dorian "Spark" Cody cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
The bearers moved Dorian "Spark" Cody's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.

Dorian "Spark" Cody never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. Dorian "Spark" Cody became a chaplain today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Dorian "Spark" Cody held a service beside a ration store. The men sang quietly so the sleepers behind the wall could rest. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian "Spark" Cody. Dorian "Spark" Cody read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Dorian "Spark" Cody only heard boots on the duckboards at P-F8, then nothing but pain. Raider: Walter Arcadialoren of the Hegemony (@arcadialoren).
Dorian "Spark" Cody drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
dawgdawghuuuuh: Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu is number 992. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.

A bullet hit Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu's belt buckle at R-R9 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Ivo "Mud" Samwade of the Concord (@its.samwade).
The medic cut the last bandage off Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-R9 the same hour.

Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu had just lit a cigarette at R-R9 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Jakub Harrison of the Concord (@alexander_p_harrison).

A bullet went through Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu's upper arm at R-R9 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli of the Concord (@mj_rahimli). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu fell at R-R9 and never moved again. Shot by Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli of the Concord (@mj_rahimli).
The House of Dawgdawghuuu sent Gustav "Doc" Dawgdawghuuu after Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Gustav "Doc" Dawgdawghuuu was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-R9. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy of the Concord (@alierayyagiyanik).
doing_sidequests: The new rifleman is Dorian Sidequests, once a railway porter from Wyvern Cross. The corporal asked if a railway porter was any use in a trench. Dorian Sidequests said he would find out.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Dorian Sidequests gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Dorian Sidequests borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
Marek Abioticsquar lent Dorian Sidequests a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
jhomey213: Lucien Jhomey reported to R-R13 with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Lucien Jhomey could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. A letter from home found Lucien Jhomey before the night shift. Lucien Jhomey folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet hit Lucien Jhomey in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-R13. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Isidor Akkugrg of the Concord (@akkugrg2012). Lucien Jhomey was killed at R-R13 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Isidor Akkugrg of the Concord (@akkugrg2012).

Wendel Jhomey took the same post at R-R13 where Lucien Jhomey stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-R13 changed before the cheering ended. Wendel Jhomey shouldered another load.
A bullet grazed Wendel Jhomey's ribs at R-R13. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Rafael Official of the Concord (@deutsches_kaiserreich_official).
The medic looked at Wendel Jhomey's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-R13. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Wendel Jhomey polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

The water jacket hissed as Wendel Jhomey fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Bastian Kal was grazed. Wendel Jhomey was carrying water up to R-R13 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Wendel Jhomey did not. Shot by Otto "Shadow" Anderson of the Concord (@tavin_anderson).
Wendel Jhomey lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.

A medic stopped by Wendel Jhomey's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Wendel Jhomey had gone back to R-R13. After what happened at the Brickworks, Wendel asked to serve as a sniper. Nobody argued.
josh_xhanley: Walter "Mud" Xhanley stepped off the supply cart at N-F4 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Fog hid the far end of N-F4. Walter "Mud" Xhanley kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout.

Walter "Mud" Xhanley gave Nils Mcwillzz the last match in the trench. Nils used it to light a candle so that Mud could finish a letter. A letter from home found Walter "Mud" Xhanley before the night shift. Walter "Mud" Xhanley folded it small and kept it close.
Walter "Mud" Xhanley and Matthias Fordlowe split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

Walter "Mud" Xhanley found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. The letter for Walter "Mud" Xhanley had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Walter "Mud" Xhanley kept them.

Walter "Mud" Xhanley fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Leopold Bezuidenhout was gravely wounded. A thin letter reached Walter "Mud" Xhanley. Only five lines long, and Walter "Mud" Xhanley knew every one of them by heart before supper.
jwger87: Gideon Jwger reached S-F20 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine. The new duty roster listed Gideon Jwger as a machine gunner. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.
A supply man offered Gideon Jwger a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.

A shell burst in the trench at S-F20. Gideon Jwger was thrown against the wall and did not get up. The bearers came at a run. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Gideon Jwger during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Gideon Jwger did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
The papers connected Bastian "Crow" Jwger to Gideon Jwger. The men took longer to learn Bastian "Crow" Jwger's own habits, but they made the effort.
Dawn watch. Bastian "Crow" Jwger put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Teodor Triplejjj, badly wounded.

The water jacket hissed as Bastian "Crow" Jwger fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Tobias Lakam was grazed. Bastian "Crow" Jwger was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-F20. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Hugo Kitty of the Concord (@buff_kitty85).
Bastian "Crow" Jwger asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
Zeno "Mud" Jwger came to the front because his brother Bastian "Crow" Jwger never came home. He carries a cracked shaving mirror.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Zeno "Mud" Jwger only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F20, then nothing but pain. Raider: Yann Theanimator of the Concord (@nico.theanimator). Zeno "Mud" Jwger walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

The wound on Zeno "Mud" Jwger's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. The clerk counted the names twice. Zeno "Mud" Jwger is number 273 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Zeno "Mud" Jwger did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
At roll call, Zeno "Mud" Jwger's place stayed empty. Someone said another section might have taken him in. A runner was sent to ask.
Zeno "Mud" Jwger returned after being cut off near the Hanging Bridge. He knew the password, but could barely make the sentry hear it.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Zeno "Mud" Jwger fired, and Florian Monkey was grazed.

Zeno "Mud" Jwger fired at a movement across the wire at S-F20. The man went down: Casimir "Owl" Mas, grazed. A splinter of duckboard, kicked up by a shell, went into Zeno "Mud" Jwger's calf. The medic pulled it out with pliers. Zeno "Mud" Jwger did not make a sound.
Zeno "Mud" Jwger rejoined the squad at S-F20. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-F20. Zeno "Mud" Jwger fired at the last man to run. Bram Yma was grazed.
kaliel.eisenblatter: The sergeant gave Viktor Eisenblatter a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.

Viktor Eisenblatter went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Concord trench Quentin Underthrone put up a fight, but not for long. (@underthrone99) The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Viktor Eisenblatter did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home found Viktor Eisenblatter before the night shift. Viktor Eisenblatter folded it small and kept it close.

A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Viktor Eisenblatter gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Viktor Eisenblatter is number 632. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Viktor Eisenblatter wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Viktor Eisenblatter did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Viktor Eisenblatter fired back. Viktor "Crow" Daone was grazed.
Viktor Eisenblatter won his boots at cards from a lance corporal in R-S17. The lance corporal wants a rematch.

Rematch. Viktor Eisenblatter lost everything he won, plus a rosary of rough beads. The whole dugout watched. Viktor Eisenblatter's transfer to the role of machine gunner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

The gun crews at R-S17 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Gustav "Rabbit" Gregrohlck was badly wounded. Viktor Eisenblatter was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S17. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Walter Jameson of the Concord (@jameson.308).
Viktor Eisenblatter's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Viktor Eisenblatter swept the enemy parapet at R-S17 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Arno "Smokes" Den was badly wounded.
karl_f_haber: The new stretcher bearer gave his name as Viktor Haber. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

Henrik "Saint" Rlhaight gave Viktor Haber the last match in the trench. Viktor used it to light a candle so that Saint could finish a letter. A letter from home reached Viktor Haber before dusk. Viktor Haber read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Viktor Haber could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Viktor Haber traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not. A letter from home reached Viktor Haber before dusk. Viktor Haber read it twice and slept a little easier.

Viktor Haber traded a pocket Bible with a hole in it for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it. A letter from home reached Viktor Haber before dusk. Viktor Haber read it twice and slept a little easier.
Viktor Haber dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.

Viktor Haber began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter. A letter from home reached Viktor Haber before dusk. Viktor Haber read it twice and slept a little easier.

A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Viktor Haber pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified. There was a letter for Viktor Haber. Someone at home had drawn a small picture in the corner. Viktor Haber laughed for the first time in days.

A bullet hit Viktor Haber in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at T-F6. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Gideon "Rabbit" Deer of the Concord (@golfer4deer). Viktor Haber was carried to the aid post and straight back out. Full. He waits on a stretcher by the door, holding a pocket Bible with a hole in it. A letter came for Viktor Haber with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Viktor Haber pinned it to the dugout wall.
leon1234.exe: The quartermaster asked Florian Exe to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
An empty jam tin became Florian Exe's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.

Florian Exe joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Victory at Blackwater Canal. Florian Exe let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Exe. Florian Exe read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A dog crosses no man's land at Lantern Hill every night, fed by Dorian Joshgentile on one side and Florian Exe on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy. The clerk counted the names twice. Florian Exe is number 589 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-S16 changed before the cheering ended. Florian Exe shouldered another load. Florian Exe asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a sapper. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Florian Exe wrote a song about the Bone Quarry. Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Exe. Florian Exe read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Florian Exe wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Exe. Florian Exe read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Wiring party. Florian Exe held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-S16, and everyone came back. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Exe. Florian Exe read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Florian Exe found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Exe. Florian Exe read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Florian Exe made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Florian Exe crawled the last yards.

The medics cleaned Florian Exe's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-S16. A letter for Florian Exe came with a photograph. Florian Exe looked at it for a long time and said nothing.
mini_i.r.s: Gustav Mini arrived on Day 6 as a replacement. The men in S-S12 had been fighting for 6 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
A football came over the parapet from the Hegemony side with Gustav Karter's name scratched on it. Gustav Mini kicked it back. It did not come again.
Gustav Mini read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
Gustav Mini began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Gustav Mini shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Hugo Mrcakerson, was grazed. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Gustav Mini looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A round went through Gustav Mini's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Cyril Rotten of the Hegemony (@str8.rotten). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Gustav Mini answered to number 466. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-S12 with the rations. Gustav Mini ate while listening to the revised orders.
The medic looked at Gustav Mini's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-S12. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
The reply to Gustav Mini's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
Gustav Mini had just lit a cigarette at S-S12 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Cyril Rotten of the Hegemony (@str8.rotten).

A round came through the loophole Gustav Mini was watching at S-S12 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Jonas "Ash" Tomar of the Hegemony (@agastya_singh_tomar_). Gustav Mini was killed outright at S-S12, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Jonas "Ash" Tomar of the Hegemony (@agastya_singh_tomar_).
Another member of the House of Mini reached the line: Benedikt "Spark" Mini. He asked where Gustav Mini had slept, then chose a different corner.
Benedikt "Spark" Mini borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Benedikt "Spark" Mini waited for that to change. When it did, Severin Thky was badly wounded.
nerrdworx_: Bastian Nerrdworx came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F7. Bastian Nerrdworx has learned to walk bent double.

Bastian Nerrdworx saw Otto "Tin" Declan freeze up on the fire step at the Sunken Road. Bastian said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Bastian Nerrdworx watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Bastian Nerrdworx cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
Bastian Nerrdworx traded a frozen apple for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Sunken Road. Cyril "Mole" Skies fired. Bastian Nerrdworx pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'
The storm put out the lamp twice. On the third attempt, Bastian Nerrdworx and two others formed a very irritated windbreak.
The patrol came back one man at a time. Bastian Nerrdworx held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.
The cook borrowed Bastian Nerrdworx's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
saturdaynightinafieldrunning: Pavel Saturdaynigh left a wife and a daughter he has never met behind in Coldwater and came up the line with a lock of hair in a matchbox. The men noticed at once that he is superstitious about the number three.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Pavel Saturdaynigh read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Pavel Saturdaynigh drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty. The clerk counted the names twice. Pavel Saturdaynigh is number 745 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is lost. Pavel Saturdaynigh heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

The gun crews at S-C4 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Lucien Zag was badly wounded. A round went through Pavel Saturdaynigh's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe of the Hegemony (@castlecrasher1).
The medic looked at Pavel Saturdaynigh's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-C4. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Pavel Saturdaynigh spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.
Pavel Saturdaynigh fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at S-C4. Before dawn Cyril Sardanonewsn walked into it, badly wounded.

Pavel Saturdaynigh smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Roland "Hollow" Dmt came out for a cup and was grazed. Two shots, one miss. The second found Quentin Oorah, grazed. Pavel Saturdaynigh cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
Machine-gun fire swept S-C4. Pavel Saturdaynigh took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Edmund "Spark" Slade of the Hegemony (@slade_2233).
storming_your_castle: Dorian Castle unpacked a bullet that missed him at T-F12. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into T-F12. Dorian Castle has learned to walk bent double.

Dorian Castle was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at T-F12. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Casimir Hyniiiis of the Hegemony (@hyniiiis). The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Dorian Castle read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Three days with a bandage, and Dorian Castle is back at T-F12. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Dorian Castle shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Albin Blakeyssss, was gravely wounded.
Dorian Castle watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.
A round went through the rim of Dorian Castle's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Teodor "Owl" Passing of the Hegemony (@_a.stranger.in_passing).
There were too few medics and too many wounded. Dorian Castle waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it.
Dorian Castle died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
The papers connected Dietrich Castle to Dorian Castle. The men took longer to learn Dietrich Castle's own habits, but they made the effort.
tamarindo_papi: Albin Papi walked into N-F2 on Day 16 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Albin Papi found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
thenightradiant: Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi came up the line with a lucky button and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

A borrowed pencil wore down while Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-R10 changed before the cheering ended. Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi shouldered another load.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
Yann Duckman and Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
Someone asked Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.

Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi (Hegemony) and Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl (Concord) came to the same broken well at Saint-Ash crossroads at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.

A bullet went into Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi's chest just under the heart at S-R10. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Gustav Jacobflamber of the Concord (@jacobflamberg). The bearers reached Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi at S-R10 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Gustav Jacobflamber of the Concord (@jacobflamberg).
The papers connected Teodor Thenightradi to Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi. The men took longer to learn Teodor Thenightradi's own habits, but they made the effort.
tiberiuswt: Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt told the sergeant he was a choir singer. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Zeno "Hollow" Batman, was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt is number 804. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-C3. Norbert Alexgreve was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt and Emil "Ghost" Fuck sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
At R-C3 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt won the bet. Hugo Gavinlordofp was badly wounded.
Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio, gravely wounded.
Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt reached up to fix a sandbag at R-C3 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat of the Concord (@mearsiecat).
The medic cut the last bandage off Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-C3 the same hour.
tiger_foster1: Nobody asked Florian Foster why he came. Nobody in W-F13 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Florian Foster drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty. Florian Foster's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Florian Foster put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.
